AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#728 @ 1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

AUD-SOL-BC1-122, agent 122; independent T4 slice audit. A/B/C = 0/1/1.

### B-728-1 — the normal audience picker discloses owner-only program names

**Normal-user story:** A sub-coach opening the broadcast audience picker receives the head coach's and sibling coaches' owner-only program names even though those programs are private to their authors. [Picker query](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/src/broadcasts/broadcasts.service.ts#L91-L96)

`src/broadcasts/broadcasts.service.ts:92` filters programs only by tenant, `is_template`, and archive status, then returns their IDs and names directly. The schema expressly says `owner_only` means only the owner can read, and the existing Programs library enforces `owner_user_id === actor` or `visibility === tenant_shared`; this new authenticated GET bypasses that private-library boundary without any special input or guessed ID. [Owner-only meaning](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/prisma/schema.prisma#L2291-L2297), [Canonical read predicate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/src/workout-builder/program-library.service.ts#L225-L240), [Ordinary route](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e97c472f00cdecbce2e5f1a680e05b1744c14715/src/broadcasts/broadcasts.controller.ts#L44-L58)

**Minimal fix:** reuse the canonical tenant + own/tenant-shared readable-master predicate in program options, and align the companion program-reference validator with it; test an actor's own private and tenant-shared masters are included, while head-coach/sibling owner-only masters are excluded and cannot be selected through this feature. [Picker](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/src/broadcasts/broadcasts.service.ts#L91-L96), [Companion validation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/15cf8e5c0f2e3e6de19a0a8f58c0c1ff6a4f76a5/src/broadcasts/segment-resolver.service.ts#L74-L79)

The independent probe executes the actual BroadcastsService against ordinary mocked rows: the picker returned **four program IDs instead of the two readable IDs**, including both other authors' owner-only masters. The probe lane's full TypeScript check passed and both finding probes failed at their expected assertions; baseline checking and 195 existing selected tests passed, which does not override this demonstrated disclosure. [Program-boundary probe lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37387147283), [Baseline CI lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37386716686)

Own prior Sol A-659-6 and B-659-1 are addressed: replay is actor-bound, started one-offs refuse edit/rearming, and recurring edits do not replace claimed run payloads. [Replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/src/broadcasts/broadcasts.service.ts#L249-L268), [Edit/resume](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/src/broadcasts/broadcasts.service.ts#L271-L380), [Prior Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/659#issuecomment-5964574829)

C-728-2 — C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): finite-series exhaustion combined with pause/resume; no investigation, probe or fix requested now. [Resume path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/src/broadcasts/broadcasts.service.ts#L350-L365)

Recommended default: fix the disclosure with B-727-1 in one round, restack for fresh exact-head audits, defer C-728-2, and keep the feature off until the full train's required CI and mobile/device gate pass. [#727](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/727), [Current checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/728/checks), [Release gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/1dd798ab36e90dbb6b3719b7a4ae13883797167f/.github/fly-env-desired-state.json)
